notes: Read here in full from the Internet Archive item 1minutesofmeeting1980sanf (60 viewer pages, 24 September to 17 December 1980), the second 1980 volume, which the first pass (appeals-1980.json, from minutesofmeeting1980sanf) did not reach. Every page's hOCR text was read, and every page whose ACTION column the OCR detaches from its appeal was read again from the page image to pair each vote with its appeal. Personal names (appellants, permit holders, 'X dba Y' proprietors) were left out at extraction; firms and businesses are kept.

coverage.remaining: Nothing in this item is unread. Not in the scan: the meetings of 15 and 29 October, 5 November (to which 9026, 9035, 9036, 9044 and 9045 were continued) and the 10 November special meeting on V8952 (183 Eureka Street); no outcome in the volume for 9051/9060 (146 McAllister, continued to 19 November and not printed there), 9070 (224 Ashbury, continued to 3 December and not printed there) or V8951 (4521 17th Street). Rehearings granted and set for 1981 or not printed: 9034 (1555 Pacific), 9016 (1122 Taraval), V9068 (2917 Octavia, 7 January 1981), 9089 (1436 25th Avenue, 7 January 1981) - the 1981 volume (appeals-1981.json) may carry them. Left out with no finding: appeal 9076 (a RAP report on a building with guest rooms, no address printed); penalties at 21 1/2 Lyell, 917 Lake and 127-31 Beulah (9082); denials to businesses never shown operating at 467 O'Farrell (9054) and 96 Golden Gate (9024, withdrawn); the 424-434 Holladay jurisdiction letter; 9006, a jurisdiction denial on Juri Street whose number the OCR garbles (the same application, 7909716, is decided as 23 Juri Street on 12 November); permits held by a person (taxi, masseuse, peddler, street artist, outcall).
coverage.note: 1980-09-24 to 1980-12-17: nine regular meetings (24 Sep; 1, 8, 22 Oct; 12, 19 Nov; 3, 10, 17 Dec). 90 numbered-address appeal items; 85 findings, two of them with no street number (Pier 39 Building M, Ghirardelli Square). Police revocations and denials of massage, adult and entertainment permits are recorded as occupancies only, never as the decision, following appeals-1980. Madame Butterfly is printed at 1172 Sutter on 1 October and 172 Sutter on 22 October; recorded at 1172. Appeal numbers jump from 9099 to 10000 in December 1980.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 2380 UNION ST → parcel 0535035; sf-parcels has blklot 0535035 active, 2380–2380 UNION; the 2025 roll records it as single family residential, built 1906.
